approval_source.reference: Brief P1g2: bppc kernel change in the baseline check, Evidence; Brief P1g3: bppc OS release in the baseline amendment, Evidence
approval_source.evidence: Gary authorized the bppc operating-system update reboot on 2026-10-15 and supplied his password; the caretaker session ran it. Brief P1g2 reports the frozen kernel is 7.0.0-28-generic and uname -r now returns 7.0.0-38-generic. Brief P1g3 reports PRETTY_NAME changed from Ubuntu 24.04.4 LTS to Ubuntu 24.04.5 LTS in the same update. The coordinator reports architecture x86_64, system Python 3.12.3, Qdrant container image and digest, Qdrant version 1.18.2 and commit remain unchanged. No other bppc machine, evidence, collection or model-file change is authorized.

scope: baseline.json remote.machine.kernel and remote.machine.os only, as the complete recorded pair from one OS update reboot; all other bppc machine, evidence, collection, model, payload, sparse fingerprint and control facts remain strict. The frozen baseline remains unchanged.
